gallery.filename: Group on the Front Steps of the Custer Home, Fort Abraham Lincoln, Dakota Territory (0825abcf6d9c4ceb96965456c4985a72).tif
gallery.title: File:Group on the Front Steps of the Custer Home, Fort Abraham Lincoln, Dakota Territory (0825abcf6d9c4ceb96965456c4985a72).tif
gallery.description:
LIBI_00019_00222; This item is a card-mounted albumen photograph of a group on the front steps of the Custer home at Fort Lincoln, D.T.  The sepia-toned photograph is 5 x 7" (8 x 10" in mount with oval overlay).  As noted on page 125 in D. Mark Katz's book, the photograph was produced circa 1874 by Orlando Scott Goff.  On the front, a handwritten notation in pencil reads, "Ft. Lincoln 1874/1 Lt. Calhoun/2 Tom/3 [illegible word]/4 Herbert Swett/5 W.C. Curtis/6 Mrs. Calhoun/7 Mrs. Curtis/8 The Misses Wadsworth of [illegible words]."  On the verso, a handwritten notation in pencil reads, "Our house at Lincoln/1865."Photograph reprinted in "The Custer Album" by Lawrence A. Frost, page 141, and "Custer in Photographs" by D. Mark Katz, page 125.; PRINT, PHOTOGRAPHIC [Mounted on card; with mat]; Courtesy of the National Park Service, Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument, LIBI_00019_00222, Orlando Scott Goff, "Group on the Front Steps of the Custer Home, Fort Lincoln, Dakota Territory," circa 1874
Keywords: little bighorn battlefield national monument

gallery.filename: Group on the Porch of General George Armstrong Custer's Quarters at Fort Abraham Lincoln (e673d26c7a72428aae98a2ce7d91e34b).tif
gallery.title: File:Group on the Porch of General George Armstrong Custer's Quarters at Fort Abraham Lincoln (e673d26c7a72428aae98a2ce7d91e34b).tif
gallery.description:
LIBI_00019_01899; An albumen card-mounted photograph of a group of men and women on the front porch of General Custer's quarters at Fort Abraham Lincoln.  The photograph is 5 3/4 x 8 1/4 (8 x 10" mounted).  As noted on page 124 of D. Mark Katz's book, the photograph was produced in 1875 by Orlando S. Goff.  The subjects are identified, from left to right, as: Leonard Swett, W.C. Curtis, Elizabeth B. Custer, Lieutenant James Calhoun, Emma Wadsworth, Lieutenant Colonel George A. Custer, 1st Lieutenant Thomas W. Custer, Margaret Custer Calhoun, 2nd Lieutenant Richard E. Thompson, Nellie Wadsworth and an unidentified soldier.  Some water damage is evident on the front of the image.  On the verso, a handwritten notation in pencil reads, "Fort Lincoln/Nellie & Emma Wadsworth/[illegible words]."  The handwritten description provided by Elizabeth B. Custer.Note: "Pkg 2" handwritten on the verso. Photograph reprinted in "The Custer Album" by Lawrence A. Frost, page 139, and "Custer in Photographs" by D
Keywords: little bighorn battlefield national monument
